backups.schedule_help: Choose a daily or weekly interval while GoRun is running. Retention counts locally verified copies only; partial, old-format and corrupt copies stay available for review. Keep recovery keys and external files separately.

backups.restore_help: Backups do not contain secret.key or gorun.toml by default: keep your own protected copy. Online: Inspect / Restore writes a confined copy under data/restores/<stamp>/ while the site keeps running. Offline: stop the service and run gorun backup-restore --input … --dest <new-directory-path> outside the data directory (the path must not exist). For a staging site or promote-to-live cutover use gorun staging seed|promote (docs/STAGING.md). Before serving a restore, move it out of the live data directory, copy the secrets, and stop every process on the old one. See docs/PRODUCTION.md.
backups.inspect_help: Preflight checks the local pair only. It does not prove a full site cutover or remote read-back.
backups.readiness.review_required: Review required — local pair looks usable; finish external checks before cutover.
backups.readiness.blocked: Blocked — fix the reported errors before restoring.
backups.restore_title: Restore to a new data directory
backups.restore_confined_help: Restore writes only into the path below (a new directory path that must not already exist). It never overwrites the live data directory while this process holds the SQLite lock.
backups.restore_confirm: Restore this backup into a new directory under restores/? The live site keeps running. To switch over, move the restored folder out of the data directory, stop the site, and point --data at it.
backups.restore_already: A restore for this stamp is already present.
backups.restore_next: Move this folder out of the live data directory (for example next to it), copy secret.key and gorun.toml into it (or set the original GORUN_SECRET_KEY), stop every process using the old data directory, then start GoRun with --data pointing at the moved folder.
backups.restored: Backup restored into a new directory under restores/. Move it out of the live data directory, copy the secrets, stop the live process, then serve with --data on the moved folder.
backups.restore_exists: That restore directory already exists; remove or rename it before restoring again.
backups.restore_blocked: Restore blocked: the local pair failed preflight. See Inspect.
backups.restore_partial: An earlier restore was interrupted and left the partial directory below. Remove it with the button below, then restore again.
backups.restore_partial_clear_confirm: Permanently delete this leftover partial restore directory? You can restore again afterward.
backups.restore_partial_cleared: Partial restore directory removed. You can restore again.
backups.restore_partial_gone: No leftover partial directory was found for this stamp.
backups.restore_partial_clear_failed: Could not remove the partial restore directory; see the server log.
backups.restore_failed: Restore failed; see the server log and Inspect.
